export_controls.text: There is no doubt that artificial intelligence, or AI, is a foundational technology with the power to transform the world. This technology, however, also raises risks for our national security.
export_controls.context: Markup hearing where Representative Madeleine Dean speaks in support of a bipartisan bill on AI export controls.
